notes: Completes FR-18 as a minimal internal Pilot Operations capability, not a general administration platform.
Internal operators never impersonate Business owners; dedicated InternalOperator commands preserve actor, target, reason/provenance and audit.
Adds compact append-only generation diagnostics without raw provider/model payloads, prompts, stack traces or end-customer data.
Adds append-only support/intervention records and bounded operator queue/detail read models.
Operator-assisted Profile correction preserves source operator-assisted, clears OwnerConfirmed, and requires a truthful owner reconfirmation path that cannot be spoofed from an owner-sourced profile.
Collaborative Opportunity preparation reuses the existing current evidence-aware generator; no free-form recommendation authoring is introduced.
Adds explicit terminal Opportunity withdrawal with required reason and optimistic concurrency; unsafe feedback alone never auto-withdraws content.
Owner Today, History, Goals and Profile navigation remains unchanged; operator routes live outside the persistent tab shell.
VS-35 is based on merged VS-34 main. Old PR #57 is preserved only as TDD/evidence history and is never a merge candidate.
No production release, deployment, EAS build/submit/OTA, production enablement or production database mutation is authorised.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner re-authorized Pilot Operations after VS-34 merged and instructed this chat to proceed while avoiding conflicts with the Today work.

VS-35 introduces no new external provider, attachment flow, release boundary or production enablement. Privileged operator authority remains governed by InternalOperator plus DEC-11 and exact-head security/product/certification gates.
Product Owner explicitly authorized fixing the stalled VS-35 RED state and proceeding through implementation and deterministic gates.
